title: Multi-Modal Content Moderation Cascades & Perceptual Hashing

spark.summary: Multi-Modal Content Moderation Cascades filter text, images, audio, and video at massive scale by placing sub-5ms perceptual hashes and regexes in front of expensive GPU vision, speech, and LLM classifiers.
spark.keyTakeaway: When inference latency or GPU memory limits bind throughput, never run heavy multimodal transformers on every upload; cascade from <5ms perceptual hashes (PDQ/PhotoDNA) to parallel encoders and cross-modal fusion.
spark.byteSummary:
Running a Vision-Language Model and Whisper ASR on every single user upload would bankrupt GPU clusters and stall publishing pipelines. Production Trust & Safety systems use a cost-tiered Moderation Cascade.

Tier 1 (<5ms CPU) checks uploaded media against known-bad perceptual hashes (PDQ/PhotoDNA, resilient to cropping and recompression) and runs Aho-Corasick / Bloom filters on text.

Only novel or ambiguous uploads advance to Tier 2, where parallel GPU encoders—CLIP Vision, Whisper ASR, and RoBERTa Toxicity—extract embeddings and transcripts into a Cross-Modal Fusion Classifier. A Policy Threshold Router then routes content to Publish, Shadowban, or Human Review.

learningJourney.title: Perceptual Hashing (PDQ & PhotoDNA)
learningJourney.purpose: Detect resized, cropped, or re-compressed violating images in <5ms.

explanation.foundation: Think of **Perceptual Hashing (PDQ & PhotoDNA)** as the intuition layer for Multi-Modal Content Moderation Cascades & Perceptual Hashing: Detect resized, cropped, or re-compressed violating images in <5ms.
explanation.core: Cryptographic hashes (SHA-256) break if a single pixel changes. Perceptual hashes (Meta PDQ, PhotoDNA) compute DCT frequency-domain fingerprints where visually similar images have a Hamming distance <= 31 bits, enabling fast multi-index lookups.
explanation.deepDive: Under heavy load or partial failure, perceptual hashing (pdq & photodna) becomes a critical lever for predictable latency and correctness. Enterprise multimodal moderation covering Unicode NFKC adversarial sanitization, cross-attention meme fusion, shadowbanning, and LLM-to-student distillation.

cards.label: Multi-Index Hashing

decisionFramework.problem: How to implement Multi-Modal Content Moderation Cascades & Perceptual Hashing without hitting unbounded tail latency, state divergence, or operational fragility.
decisionFramework.naiveSolution: Use a single unpartitioned path with unbounded retries and synchronous global coordination.
decisionFramework.whyItFails: Global coordination serializes throughput under load, while unbounded retries amplify transient stalls into full outages.
decisionFramework.alternatives: Compare synchronous strict-consistency paths against bounded asynchronous replication, local caching, or partitioned ownership.
decisionFramework.decision: When inference latency or GPU memory limits bind throughput, never run heavy multimodal transformers on every upload; cascade from <5ms perceptual hashes (PDQ/PhotoDNA) to parallel encoders and cross-modal fusion.
decisionFramework.tradeOffs: Gains predictable p99 latency and fault isolation in exchange for explicit bounding, observability, and slightly higher implementation complexity.

learningJourney.title: Parallel Modality Encoders & Video Keyframing
learningJourney.purpose: Process video, audio, and text concurrently without decoding every frame.

explanation.core: Extracting I-frames / scene-change keyframes (e.g., 1 fps) cuts vision compute by 30x.
explanation.deepDive: Simultaneously, Whisper ASR transcribes the audio track and RoBERTa scores captions/comments in parallel.

learningJourney.codeExample:
async def encode_multimodal_asset(video_path, caption):
    keyframes = await extract_scene_keyframes(video_path, max_fps=1.0)
    vision_task = clip_pool.encode_images(keyframes)
    audio_task = whisper_pool.transcribe(video_path)
    text_task = roberta_pool.score(caption)
    return await asyncio.gather(vision_task, audio_task, text_task)

learningJourney.title: Policy Threshold Routing & Shadowbanning
learningJourney.purpose: Route borderline content to human moderators while silently throttling viral spam.

explanation.foundation: Think of **Policy Threshold Routing & Shadowbanning** as the intuition layer for Multi-Modal Content Moderation Cascades & Perceptual Hashing: Route borderline content to human moderators while silently throttling viral spam.
explanation.core: A single binary threshold creates too many appeals. High-confidence violations (>0.95) auto-takedown, mid-confidence (0.60–0.95) enter a priority Human Review Queue (weighted by viral view velocity), and spam bots get shadowbanned so they don't immediately spin up new accounts.
explanation.deepDive: Under heavy load or partial failure, policy threshold routing & shadowbanning becomes a critical lever for predictable latency and correctness. learningJourney.title: Adversarial Evasion & Homoglyph Normalization
learningJourney.purpose: Defeat leetspeak, zero-width Unicode characters, and adversarial pixel noise.

explanation.foundation: Think of **Adversarial Evasion & Homoglyph Normalization** as the intuition layer for Multi-Modal Content Moderation Cascades & Perceptual Hashing: Defeat leetspeak, zero-width Unicode characters, and adversarial pixel noise.
explanation.core: Spammers bypass keyword filters using Unicode homoglyphs (Cyrillic 'а' for Latin 'a') and zero-width joiners. Text normalization (NFKC + confusable mapping) before tokenization and JPEG-compression/Gaussian-blur preprocessing before CLIP neutralize common adversarial perturbations.
explanation.deepDive: Under heavy load or partial failure, adversarial evasion & homoglyph normalization becomes a critical lever for predictable latency and correctness. Enterprise multimodal moderation covering Unicode NFKC adversarial sanitization, cross-attention meme fusion, shadowbanning, and LLM-to-student distillation.

knowledgeChecks.question: Why do moderation pipelines run PDQ/PhotoDNA perceptual hashing instead of SHA-256 for image matching?

options.text: Perceptual hashes remain within a small Hamming distance even if an adversary crops, resizes, or re-compresses the image
options.feedback: Correct! SHA-256 changes completely on a 1-bit flip, whereas PDQ/PhotoDNA preserve visual similarity.
SHA-256 can hash any byte stream, it just fails on minor visual edits.

options.text: PhotoDNA automatically transcribes spoken audio in videos
options.feedback: Whisper ASR transcribes audio; PhotoDNA hashes images.

options.text: PDQ hashes run exclusively on NVIDIA GPUs
options.feedback: PDQ runs very fast on standard CPUs.

knowledgeChecks.explanation: Perceptual hashing captures frequency-domain structure resilient to adversarial resizing and compression.

knowledgeChecks.question: How should items inside the Human Review Queue be prioritized when moderator capacity is limited?

options.text: Strict FIFO (oldest upload first) regardless of reach
options.feedback: FIFO wastes moderator time on zero-view spam while viral harmful posts spread.

options.text: Sort by (Violation Probability x Viral View Velocity) so high-reach risky posts are reviewed first
options.feedback: Correct! Impact-weighted triage minimizes total harmful impressions.

options.text: Review only text posts and ignore all video uploads
options.feedback: Ignoring video leaves a massive safety gap.

options.text: Randomly sample 1% of uploads and delete the rest
options.feedback: Deleting unreviewed uploads destroys legitimate user content.

knowledgeChecks.explanation: Prioritizing human review by risk score multiplied by live view velocity minimizes total user harm.

knowledgeChecks.question: A user posts a meme with an innocent photo and innocent caption text, but text rendered inside the image pixels forms a policy violation. Which pipeline step catches this?

options.text: Aho-Corasick matching on the caption alone
options.feedback: Caption-only matching never sees text embedded inside image pixels.

options.text: OCR extraction combined with CLIP visual embeddings in a Cross-Modal Fusion classifier
options.feedback: Correct! Extracting embedded OCR text and fusing it with visual tokens catches multimodal meme violations.
Static memes have no audio track.

options.text: Unicode NFKC normalization on the username
options.feedback: Username normalization does not inspect image pixels.

knowledgeChecks.explanation: OCR + Cross-Modal Fusion evaluates visual context alongside overlaid text.
